clusters.agenda_text: Merck and Moderna reports that their cancer vaccine candidate showed positive results in their late-stage trial in preventing a recurrence of melanoma, including in high-risk patients
clusters.headline: Moderna and Merck announce positive results for experimental skin cancer vaccine
clusters.summary: Moderna and Merck have reported positive results from late-stage trials of an experimental vaccine targeting advanced melanoma. The announcement drove significant stock increases for both companies, with Moderna's stock rising 90 percent. The vaccine represents progress in developing immunotherapy treatments for skin cancer.

clusters.agenda_text: Iran says it barred two French embassy employees from returning for allegedly violating the Vienna Convention through activities supporting Iranian civil society. France says their work involved programs for civil society, students, and artists
clusters.headline: Iran bars two French embassy employees from returning
clusters.summary: Iran said it prevented two French embassy employees from returning to the country, accusing them of violating the Vienna Convention through activities that supported Iranian civil society. France stated that the employees' work involved programs for civil society, students, and artists.

clusters.agenda_text: Thai rescuers find a French tourist and his two sons alive after they spend more than 16 hours at sea when their rented jet ski capsizes off Ko Samui. The family receives medical checks and is discharged
clusters.headline: French family rescued after drifting off Thailand coast for 16 hours
clusters.summary: A French family was rescued after spending more than 16 hours adrift off the coast of Thailand, according to a report from La Vanguardia. The family was recovered following what appears to have been a maritime incident, though specific details about their situation and rescue operation are not provided in the available reporting.

clusters.agenda_text: The Constitutional Council of France blocks a bill proposing a ban social media access for minors under the age of 15. President Emmanuel Macron orders prime minister Sebastien Lecornu to re-work the draft legislation and resubmit it to the Council
clusters.headline: France's Constitutional Council rejects social media ban for minors under 15
clusters.summary: France's Constitutional Council has blocked legislation that would have prohibited social media access for children under the age of 15. Following the rejection, President Emmanuel Macron has instructed Prime Minister Sebastian Lecornu to revise the draft bill and resubmit it to the Council for further review.
